final: WITH status_rates AS (SELECT sites.healtheval, AVG(scans.gbsize / scans.spanmin) AS rate, COUNT(DISTINCT sites.zoneregistry) AS site_count FROM scans JOIN sites ON scans.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry GROUP BY sites.healtheval), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM status_rates) SELECT AVG(status_rates.rate) AS avg_rate, AVG(status_rates.site_count) AS avg_distinct_sites, AVG(status_rates.rate - overall.avg_rate) AS avg_excess_rate FROM status_rates CROSS JOIN overall WHERE status_rates.rate > overall.avg_rate
